verdicts.reason: A puts the SOLSTICE wordmark below the headline, which breaks the reading order. Its flavour pills are shrunk to near-illegible size, flipped into reverse order and spread across the canvas with uneven gaps, and the oversized CTA crowds the right edge and competes with the headline, while the copy sits jammed against the left edge. B keeps the original's hierarchy, alignment, pill group and CTA almost exactly; the only flaws are slightly enlarged decorative circles (the yellow one now sits behind more of the text) and small pill labels, both minor polish.
